title: Port mustache.js to Rust, judged by the Mustache spec (S/M boundary)
prompt: /workspace holds mustache.js, a logic-less template engine in JavaScript. Port it to a Rust crate in /workspace/rust (edition 2021, serde_json allowed) with the same behaviour, and a binary, mustache-port, that reads {"template", "data", "partials"} JSON on stdin and writes the rendered text. Do not change the JavaScript. Reply with a short summary when done.

judge.command: cargo build --release && python3 judge/run_spec.py target/release/mustache-port specs/*.json
judge.cases: about 200 cases (comments, delimiters, interpolation, inverted, partials, sections; lambdas optional)
judge.image: rust:1.84-bookworm with python3, serde_json vendored; --cpus 4, no network

source.why: The cheapest real cross-language port with a language-independent judge: the first Tier M to build, to shake out the judge images and job() before the hour-long ones.
source.prepare: Copy mustache.js and its README into input/; vendor serde_json for the offline build.
